requirements.text: The Speech Text Reader must allow users to toggle the visibility of the text box—containing the voice dropdown, textarea, and "Read Text" button—by clicking the "Toggle Text Box" button (data-testid="toggle-button"). Initially hidden, the text box (data-testid="text-box") should appear or disappear based on user interaction, with visibility controlled by the presence of the 'show' class. The system must handle normal toggles, rapid repeated clicks, and boundary conditions reliably, ensuring the final state reflects the last user action without inconsistency.å√

The web application should allow users to toggle the visibility of a text box using a 'Toggle Text Box' button and hide the text box using a 'Close' button. The text box is initially hidden. When the user clicks the 'Toggle Text Box' button, located in the DOM with the attribute data-testid='toggle-button', the text box, identified by data-testid='text-box', becomes visible. Within the visible text box, there is a 'Close' button, identified by data-testid='close-button'. When the user clicks this 'Close' button, the text box should be hidden again. The visibility of the text box is controlled by adding or removing the 'show' class from the text box element in the DOM.

The system must populate the 'Choose Voice' dropdown (data-testid='voice-select') with available voices from the Web Speech API after the user opens the text box using the 'Toggle Text Box' button (data-testid='toggle-button'). Once the text box (data-testid='text-box') becomes visible, the system invokes the getVoices function, which retrieves the voices using speechSynthesis.getVoices(), and populates the dropdown with option elements whose values are set to the voice names and whose display texts show the voice names and languages. If the available voices change, the system listens for the 'voiceschanged' event and updates the dropdown accordingly. When a user selects a voice, it is assigned to message.voice for speech synthesis.

The Speech Text Reader web application must allow users to select a voice from the 'Choose Voice' dropdown, identified by data-testid='voice-select'. Upon selection, the system should set the chosen voice for speech synthesis. The dropdown should be populated with available voices when the page is fully loaded. The system must handle multiple voice selections, ensuring that the last selected voice is set as the active voice for speech synthesis. The application should support voice options that include specific language codes, such as 'CN' for Chinese or 'US' for English, and accurately set the voice containing these codes as the active voice when selected.

The Speech Text Reader application must allow users to enter text into the textarea (data-testid='text-area') and read it aloud using a selected voice from the dynamically populated dropdown (data-testid='voice-select'). When the user toggles the text box (data-testid='text-box') via the 'Toggle Text Box' button (data-testid='toggle-button') and clicks the 'Read Text' button (data-testid='read-button'), the system must use the selected voice to read the entered text aloud.

The system must dynamically generate predefined phrase boxes, located in the main section, based on a data array. Each box contains an image () and a paragraph (

...

) representing a phrase. When a user clicks on a box, the system must read the associated text aloud using the Web Speech API and visually highlight the box by adding the active class for 800 milliseconds. The system must correctly handle normal clicks, sequential clicks across different boxes, and rapid repeated clicks on the same box, ensuring that speech playback and visual feedback are triggered accurately for each interaction.

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Toggle text box visibility on button click
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Toggle Text Box Visibility
  The system should toggle the visibility of the text box containing the voice selection dropdown, textarea, and 'Read Text' button when the user clicks the 'Toggle Text Box' button.


  Scenario: [Normal] Toggle text box visibility on button click
    Given the Speech Text Reader page is loaded
    And the text box with data-testid "text-box" is initially hidden
    When the user clicks the 'Toggle Text Box' button with data-testid "toggle-button"
    Then the text box with data-testid "text-box" should be visible

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Toggle text box visibility off on button click
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Toggle Text Box Visibility
  The system should toggle the visibility of the text box containing the voice selection dropdown, textarea, and 'Read Text' button when the user clicks the 'Toggle Text Box' button.


  Scenario: [Normal] Toggle text box visibility off on button click
    Given the Speech Text Reader page is loaded
    And the user clicks the 'Toggle Text Box' button with data-testid "toggle-button"
    And the text box with data-testid "text-box" is visible
    When the user clicks the 'Toggle Text Box' button with data-testid "toggle-button"
    Then the text box with data-testid "text-box" should be hidden

reference_cases.title: [Edge] Toggle text box visibility rapidly
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Toggle Text Box Visibility
  The system should toggle the visibility of the text box containing the voice selection dropdown, textarea, and 'Read Text' button when the user clicks the 'Toggle Text Box' button.


  Scenario: [Edge] Toggle text box visibility rapidly
    Given the Speech Text Reader page is loaded
    And the text box with data-testid "text-box" is initially hidden
    When the user rapidly clicks the 'Toggle Text Box' button with data-testid "toggle-button" multiple times
    Then the text box with data-testid "text-box" should eventually be visible or hidden based on the final click

reference_cases.title: [Normal] User clicks the 'Close' button to hide the text box
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Hide Text Box on Close Button Click
  The system should hide the text box when the user clicks the 'Close' button within the text box.


Scenario: [Normal] User clicks the 'Close' button to hide the text box
    Given the Speech Text Reader page is loaded
    And  the user clicks the "Toggle Text Box" button with data-testid "toggle-button"
    And the text box is visible with data-testid 'text-box'
    When the user clicks the 'Close' button with data-testid 'close-button'
    Then the text box should not be visible

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Populate voices dropdown on page load
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Populate 'Choose Voice' Dropdown
  The system should populate the 'Choose Voice' dropdown with available voices from the Web Speech API when the page loads or when the available voices change.


Scenario: [Normal] Populate voices dropdown on page load
    Given the Speech Text Reader page is loaded
    When the page is initialized
    And the user clicks the 'Toggle Text Box' button with data-testid "toggle-button" to display the text box
    Then the 'Choose Voice' dropdown with data-testid 'voice-select' should be populated with available voices from the Web Speech API

reference_cases.title: [Normal] User selects a voice from the dropdown
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Set selected voice for speech synthesis
  The system should allow the user to select a voice from the "Choose Voice" dropdown, and the selected voice should be set for speech synthesis.


Scenario: [Normal] User selects a voice from the dropdown
   Given the Speech Text Reader page has fully loaded
   And the user clicks the 'Toggle Text Box' button identified by data-testid="toggle-button" to reveal the text box
   And the 'Choose Voice' dropdown identified by data-testid="voice-select" is populated with available voices
   When the user selects an option from the 'Choose Voice' dropdown (data-testid='voice-select') where the option text includes 'US'
   Then the system should set the voice containing 'US' as the active voice for speech synthesis

reference_cases.title: [Normal] User enters text and clicks 'Read Text' button
reference_cases.description:
Feature: REQ-005 - Text Reading Functionality
  The system should read aloud the text entered by the user in the textarea using the selected voice when the 'Read Text' button is clicked.


Scenario: [Normal] User enters text and clicks 'Read Text' button
    Given the Speech Text Reader page is loaded
    And the user clicks the "Toggle Text Box" button with data-testid "toggle-button" to display the text box
    And the user enters "Hello World" into the textarea with data-testid "text-area"
    And the user selects a voice from the dropdown with data-testid "voice-select"
    When the user clicks the "Read Text" button with data-testid "read-button"
    Then the system should read aloud "Hello World" using the selected voice

reference_cases.title: [Edge] User enters a long text and clicks 'Read Text' button
reference_cases.description:
Feature: REQ-005 - Text Reading Functionality
  The system should read aloud the text entered by the user in the textarea using the selected voice when the 'Read Text' button is clicked.


Scenario: [Edge] User enters a long text and clicks 'Read Text' button
    Given the Speech Text Reader page is loaded
    And the user clicks the "Toggle Text Box" button with data-testid "toggle-button" to display the text box
    And the user enters a long text into the textarea with data-testid "text-area"
    And the user selects a voice from the dropdown with data-testid "voice-select"
    When the user clicks the "Read Text" button with data-testid "read-button"
    Then the system should read aloud "Hello World" using the selected voice

reference_cases.title: [Edge] User enters text and changes voice before clicking 'Read Text' button
reference_cases.description:
Feature: REQ-005 - Text Reading Functionality
  The system should read aloud the text entered by the user in the textarea using the selected voice when the 'Read Text' button is clicked.


Scenario: [Edge] User enters text and changes voice before clicking 'Read Text' button
    Given the Speech Text Reader page is loaded
    And the user clicks the "Toggle Text Box" button with data-testid "toggle-button" to display the text box
    And the user enters "Testing voice change" into the textarea with data-testid 'text-area'
    And the user selects a voice from the dropdown with data-testid 'voice-select'
    And the user changes the voice selection to another voice
    When the user clicks the 'Read Text' button with data-testid 'read-button'
    Then the system should read aloud "Testing voice change" using the newly selected voice

reference_cases.title: [Error] User clicks 'Read Text' button without entering text
reference_cases.description:
Feature: REQ-005 - Text Reading Functionality
  The system should read aloud the text entered by the user in the textarea using the selected voice when the 'Read Text' button is clicked.


Scenario: [Error] User clicks 'Read Text' button without entering text
    Given the Speech Text Reader page is loaded
    And the user clicks the "Toggle Text Box" button with data-testid "toggle-button" to display the text box
    And the textarea with data-testid 'text-area' is empty
    And the user selects a voice from the dropdown with data-testid 'voice-select'
    When the user clicks the 'Read Text' button with data-testid 'read-button'
    Then the system should not read aloud any text

reference_cases.title: [Normal] User clicks on a predefined phrase box
reference_cases.description:
Feature: REQ-006 - Predefined Phrase Box Interaction
  The system should allow users to click on predefined phrase boxes, triggering the associated text to be read aloud and visually highlighting the box momentarily.


  Scenario: [Normal] User clicks on a predefined phrase box
    Given the webpage is loaded and all predefined phrase boxes are displayed in the main section
    When the user clicks on the box containing the text "I'm Thirsty"
    Then the system should read aloud the text "I'm Thirsty"
    And the box should visually highlight by adding the "active" class
    And the highlight should disappear after 800 milliseconds

reference_cases.title: [Normal] User clicks on multiple predefined phrase boxes sequentially
reference_cases.description:
Feature: REQ-006 - Predefined Phrase Box Interaction
  The system should allow users to click on predefined phrase boxes, triggering the associated text to be read aloud and visually highlighting the box momentarily.


  Scenario: [Normal] User clicks on multiple predefined phrase boxes sequentially
    Given the webpage is loaded and all predefined phrase boxes are displayed in the main section
    When the user clicks on the box containing the text "I'm Hungry"
    Then the system should read aloud the text "I'm Hungry"
    And the box should visually highlight by adding the "active" class
    And the highlight should disappear after 800 milliseconds
    When the user clicks on the box containing the text "I'm Happy"
    Then the system should read aloud the text "I'm Happy"
    And the box should visually highlight by adding the "active" class
    And the highlight should disappear after 800 milliseconds

reference_cases.title: [Edge] User clicks on a predefined phrase box repeatedly in quick succession
reference_cases.description:
Feature: REQ-006 - Predefined Phrase Box Interaction
  The system should allow users to click on predefined phrase boxes, triggering the associated text to be read aloud and visually highlighting the box momentarily.


  Scenario: [Edge] User clicks on a predefined phrase box repeatedly in quick succession
    Given the webpage is loaded and all predefined phrase boxes are displayed in the main section
    When the user clicks on the box containing the text "I'm Angry" three times in quick succession
    Then the system should read aloud the text "I'm Angry" three times
    And the box should visually highlight by adding the "active" class each time
    And the highlight should disappear after 800 milliseconds for each click
